list.notes: One tr[data-filters] per gem (the HTML nests rows inside cells, so read the gem anchor's following siblings): anchor text = name, '(N)' = tier, div.gem_tags = tag anchors. Anchor class gem_red/green/blue = attribute colour, gemitem = no colour.

summary.notes: Card layout (no <tr>); same gem anchors plus a.GemTags; not used by the collector.

gemcutting.notes: Rows whose first cell contains 'weapon' are weapon-set rows, not classes.

list.notes: One tr[data-filters] per gem (the HTML nests rows inside cells, so read the gem anchor's following siblings): anchor text = name, '(N)' = tier, div.gem_tags = tag anchors. Anchor class gem_red/green/blue = attribute colour, gemitem = no colour.

One tr[data-filters] per gem (the HTML nests rows inside cells, so read the gem anchor's following siblings): anchor text = name, '(N)' = tier, div.gem_tags = tag anchors. Anchor class gem_red/green/blue = attribute colour, gemitem = no colour.

summary.notes: Card layout with a.GemTags; not used by the collector.

gem_tags.notes: Gems grouped by tag (card layout, no tier). Contains ~54 supports absent from the list pane, so it is part of the gem universe.

all_gems.notes: One row per support tier 1-5 listing every gem of that tier.

popup.notes: Repeated up to 4x per page (one per level preview); index 0 is the canonical one with Tier/Cost.

level_effect.locate: first <table> whose first two <th> are 'Level' and 'Requires Level'
level_effect.heading: Level Effect /N
level_effect.notes: Per-level progression; column set varies per gem. Support gems show a single row plus an implicit 'Mana: N%' cell.

attributes.notes: Id is the game-internal identifier (e.g. LeapSlam, AddedFireDamageSupport). Acronym lists the keyword pages the skill text refers to as plain <a href="/us/<Keyword>"> links (no hover hash).

implicit.locate: <table> whose only <th> is 'Implicit', in the same pane as the level table
implicit.notes: Support gems: first cell is 'Mana: N%' (mana multiplier) followed by the support's stat lines.

supported_by.notes: Every support gem that can support this skill (gem anchors, GemEffects_hover). First <li> lists the skill's Active Types.

passive_tree_svg.notes: Superseded for structure by pob2_tree (2026-11-10). Node pages are 1.2 MB because each embeds the full SVG tree; do not crawl them per node.

pob2_tree.notes: Structural source for the passive tree: every node, connections, names, stats, keystone/notable/attribute/jewel flags, classesStart, ascendancyName, isAscendancyStart, group/orbit positions. 0_5 is a superset of poe2db's SVG ids (4115/4115) and matches 1230/1231 poe2db names. isOnlyImage nodes are decorative masteries and are dropped.

keyword_hover.notes: ~1.2 KB snippet: .card-header a (name + slug), .keyword-body (explanation with nested KeywordPopups links). The full /<lang>/<Keyword> page is ~1.7 MB; use the hover. Hashes are per language and not derivable; harvest them from anchors.

passive_tree_data.notes: Data file behind poe2db's passive tree viewer, one per language, same node ids as PoB2 (4546/4546 of our tree nodes). Used for text only: zh-TW name and stat lines of every node (joined by id, English name must agree) and class / ascendancy names. Existing zh names from the listing cards agree 1224/1224. Structure still comes from pob2_tree.

gem.slug.semantics: Language-independent page slug; primary key across /us/ and /tw/.

gem.level_range.notes: Support gems have no 'Level:' property (always null); their level table has one row.

gem.requires_level.semantics: Character level needed at gem level min..max.
gem.requires_level.notes: Fixed-level gems (e.g. lineage supports) show 'Requires: Level 65' without a range; stored as [65, 65].

gem.requires_stats.source: requirements containing 'Level' (text after the level part) or 'Support Requirements'
gem.requires_stats.semantics: Attribute requirement range, e.g. '(4 — 157) Str' or '+5 Str'.

gem.requires_weapons.source: item_classes in requirements; plain text fallback
gem.requires_weapons.semantics: Weapon classes; 'Any Martial Weapon' is plain text.

gem.main_stat.semantics: Headline scaling stat such as 'Attack Damage: (110 — 449)% of base'.
gem.main_stat.notes: Null is normal for buffs, auras and most spirit gems (no 'label: value' property). 2026-11-10 run: null for 36% of skill, 89% of spirit, 58% of support gems.

gem.level_effects.semantics: Per-level rows keyed by column header.

gem.game_id.semantics: Game-internal id; stable across patches and languages.

skill_gem.tier.semantics: Gemcutting tier, odd numbers 1-13. Null for gems not obtainable from uncut gems (e.g. granted skills).
skill_gem.tier.notes: 2026-11-10 run: 165 of 400 skill gems show no Tier in the popup; the collector backfills it from the listing row and adds parse_warning 'tier_from_listing'.

skill_gem.cost.semantics: Flat resource cost range, e.g. '(14 — 97) Mana'.

support_gem.tier.semantics: Support tier 1-5; a separate scale from skill/spirit tiers.

support_gem.cost.semantics: Mana cost multiplier applied to the supported skill, not a flat cost.
support_gem.cost.notes: Absent on supports that do not change cost.

support_gem.category.semantics: Exclusivity group: only one support per category per skill.

passive.id.source: svg circle id (numeric PassiveSkillsHash) or slug for timeless nodes

passive.name.source: poe2db listing card when the node has a page, else pob2 name

passive.stats.source: poe2db listing card stats when the node has a page, else pob2 stats (stats_source says which)

passive.position.semantics: PoB2 tree units; null for timeless jewel nodes.

passive.class_start.source: pob2 classesStart filtered to PoE2 class names
passive.class_start.semantics: Classes that start at this node (two classes can share a start).

gem.extra_properties.semantics: Player-facing stat lines shown in the gem tooltip.

gem.hidden_stats.semantics: Internal stat ids poe2db shows under 'Show hidden stats', e.g. 'is area damage [1]'. Useful for mechanics questions, not for display.

gem.keyword_slugs.source: popup a.KeywordPopups (minus GemTags / ItemClasses) + attribute Acronym links
gem.keyword_slugs.semantics: Glossary terms the gem text refers to; each slug is a keyword page.

skill_gem.supported_by.semantics: Support gem slugs poe2db lists as able to support this skill.

passive.slug.semantics: poe2db page slug; null for nodes without a page (small, attribute, ascendancy, class start).

passive.keyword_slugs.source: KeywordPopups links in the listing card stats

passive.name_zh_tw.source: poe2db /tw/ listing card when the node has a page, else poe2db passive tree data (zh_source says which)

passive.stats_zh_tw.source: poe2db /tw/ listing card, else poe2db passive tree data when its lines align one-to-one with the English lines; empty otherwise

class.name_zh_tw.source: poe2db passive tree data (classes[].name, ascendancies[].name), paired with the English file by position and id

passive.unlock_ascendancy.source: pob2 unlockConstraint.ascendancy: the node can only be allocated by that ascendancy (176 Oracle-only nodes in 0_5); constraints without an ascendancy are stored as null

class.points.source: poe2db passive tree data points.totalPoints / points.ascendancyPoints

traps: The gem popup is repeated up to 4 times per detail page; only index 0 carries Tier and Cost/Reservation.
'Any Martial Weapon' is plain text inside .requirements, not an a.ItemClasses link.
Numeric ranges use a spaced em dash: '(1 — 20)'. Older pages used '(1—20)'.
Requirement text is split across spans: 'Requires: Level (1 — 90) , (4 — 157) Str'.
Support gems have no 'Cost:' property; the mana multiplier lives in the Level Effect table as 'Mana: N%'.
Support gems use 'Support Requirements : +5 Str' instead of a Level requirement line.
Tier means a different scale per gem kind (skill 1-13 odd, spirit 4/8/14, support 1-5).
Some /tw/ tab-pane ids are localized (技能寶石, 精神寶石, 輔助寶石, 核心天賦Passive); Gemcutting, TierLevel and GemTags are not.
Passive data-hover hashes differ per language; join /us/ and /tw/ passive names by href slug.
Ascendancy and small nodes have no poe2db page; their names and stats come from PathOfBuilding-PoE2 tree.json (pob2_tree.version).
Small passive nodes have no name or stats on poe2db.

Listing rows are tr[data-filters] (data-tags is gone); gem anchors are recognised by data-hover containing GemEffects_hover, with class gem_red/gem_green/gem_blue (attribute colour) or gemitem (no colour).
Hidden internal stats sit inside .explicitMod as <span class='secondary collapse'>; keep them out of extra_properties.
Passive node pages embed the whole SVG tree (~1.2 MB each); per-node data comes from listing cards and hover snippets instead.
Keyword pages are ~1.7 MB; the KeywordPopups hover snippet (~1.2 KB) carries the same explanation.
Hover hashes are language-specific and not derivable from the slug; harvest them from anchors in each language.
In the gem popup, GemTags and ItemClasses anchors also carry the KeywordPopups class; exclude them when collecting glossary terms.
PoB2 classesStart uses PoE1 internal names alongside PoE2 ones (['Witch', 'Sorceress'], ['Marauder', 'Warrior']); keep only names in tree.classes.
Some glossary terms appear only in gem descriptions; their zh-TW hover hash comes from the gem's zh-TW GemEffects hover (~6 KB), not from any listing page.
PoB2 node['group'] is 1-based: the group is tree['groups'][group - 1].
Several tree nodes can share a notable name with different stats; the poe2db card is joined to the best stat match only.

poe2db passive tree data: stat lines carry keyword markup ([Key|text] or [text]) that must be stripped, and the classes list also holds classes with no start node on the PoE2 tree (Marauder, Duelist, Shadow, Templar); keep only classes that start on our tree.
